bio: Nature takes centre stage at De Swarte Ruijter. Located on the Holterberg, this charming thatched house boasts stunning views of the nearby pine forest and seamlessly incorporates natural elements into its interior design. Erik de Mönnink draws inspiration from the beautiful surroundings, which fuel his creativity every day. His unconventional cuisine showcases locally sourced produce such as mushrooms, venison and nagelhout (air-dried veal). This chef knows how to captivate his diners, creating fascinating dishes featuring playful contrasts in texture. His daring combinations are sometimes quite astonishing.
